title: Registry Access Pattern - Multiple Tool Failures
problem: Multiple forensics tools fail when accessing HKLM registry: registryRunKeys, registryRunOnce, timeline. All blocked by permission boundary (HKLM read requires admin)
evidence: timeline: Access denied on C:\Windows\System32\config\Sam (raw registry)
cause: HKLM registry hive requires admin/system privileges for deep inspection. Current execution context lacks SeSecurityPrivilege. Same root cause as IC-002/IC-006 (permission boundary)

recommended_actions.action: Create permission boundary wrapper: detect admin context before querying HKLM
Document admin requirement in tool descriptions and error messages
Provide HKCU fallback: read current-user registry as alternative visibility

notes: Pattern issue: affects 3+ tools. One fix will solve multiple tools. Similar to IC-002 privilege boundary
